parameters.name: filter[queue]
parameters.description: Filter to a single Horizon queue name. Also accepts the flat `queue=` form.

parameters.name: filter[supervisor]
parameters.description: Filter to a single supervisor name. Derived from queueToSupervisorMap (queue → supervisor). Useful for drilling in from the Queues table on the overview.

parameters.name: filter[tenant_id]
parameters.description: Filter to jobs tagged with the given tenant id (from the Horizon `tenant:<id>` job tag).

parameters.name: filter[class]
parameters.description: Substring match against the job's FQCN.

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring search across class, queue, tenant_id, and id.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Spatie-style sort key. Prefix with `-` for descending. Allowed keys: `class`, `queue`, `supervisor`, `tenant_id`, `completed_at`, `runtime_seconds`, `attempts`. Default is `-completed_at` (newest-first) when omitted.
